_comment: Every flaw in this fixture is deliberate and recorded here with the line it lives on and the acceptance criterion that needs it. Line numbers are generated from the files, not hand-counted. If tests/test_fixture_repo.py fails, the fixture has drifted: re-generate this file rather than editing the line numbers by hand.
